note: Small SRA on a 45-acre spring-fed lake near Verdon in SE Nebraska (electric-motor and non-powered boats only, no ramp or dock). Shady campground: sites 1-15 along the west shore, several on the grass between the campground road and the water; sites 16-20 along the east bank. Picnic tables; reported to accommodate larger rigs. --Claude
summary: Still NGPC (Active SRA, on the 2025 grid). 20 Basic sites, no electric, FCFS iron ranger confirmed (Aug 2026 capture + NGPC site layer). Fees left; facilities left (page says only 'primitive restrooms'). PIN ~210 m off, on the county road: move. WATERFRONT not waterfront -> lakefront proposed (NGPC per-site points + legible imagery). Lake is 45 acres, not 50.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront -> lakefront (UPGRADE, re-audit). NGPC's own per-site layer puts sites 9-15 on the lake side of the west-shore campground road, on a mowed grass strip ~10-25 m from the 45-acre lake. At sites 13-15 the strip runs open to the shoreline with only scattered trees: an open, unused apron inside the distance bound, with no road or day-use area between. Sites 7-12 have a tree fringe on the shore (filtered views, lakeview). Sites 16-20 are on the land side of the east-bank road (lakeview). The June 2026 sweep's 'not waterfront' bucket gave no per-site detail. If the shoreline strip at 13-15 is a used path, the call falls to lakeview, which every site supports.
